integrity_notes: Proof and enumerators corroborated by exact symbolic construction in 124 finite examples; arbitrary-dimension claim rests on the given Witt-extension argument, not on finite data.
scientific_limitations: Fields algebraically closed of characteristic different from two.
Rank-one square only, including degenerate cases.
Counts graph patterns, not natural bases or isomorphism classes.

title: Complete graph spectra of rank-one evolution algebras over algebraically closed fields
